learning_rules: No book grants enlightenment, hyper unique powers, or circle rank.
Spell requires at least required_circle; level alone cannot substitute circle.
Studying a manual unlocks understanding of its technique; practice governs reliable combat use.
Books remain as collectible items; no consumption on first reading; copying may require permission.
No magic book can be officially traded or registered outside Draken specialized institutions.
